hooks.command: SCAN="${CODEX_PROJECT_DIR:-$PWD}"; PROJECT_ROOT=""; while [ "$SCAN" != "/" ]; do if [ -f "$SCAN/.codex/hooks.json" ] && [ ! -L "$SCAN/.codex/hooks.json" ] && [ ! -L "$SCAN/.codex" ] && [ ! -L "$SCAN/.codex/hooks" ] && [ -f "$SCAN/.codex/hooks/pretool-guard.sh" ] && [ -x "$SCAN/.codex/hooks/pretool-guard.sh" ] && [ ! -L "$SCAN/.codex/hooks/pretool-guard.sh" ]; then PROJECT_ROOT="$SCAN"; break; fi; SCAN="$(dirname "$SCAN")"; done; if [ -z "$PROJECT_ROOT" ]; then printf "%s\n" "workspace harness root could not be resolved" >&2; exit 2; fi; HANDLER="$PROJECT_ROOT/.codex/hooks/pretool-guard.sh"; if [ ! -f "$HANDLER" ] || [ ! -x "$HANDLER" ] || [ -L "$HANDLER" ]; then printf "%s\n" "workspace harness handler is unavailable" >&2; exit 2; fi; WORKSPACE_BUILDER_PROJECT_ROOT="$PROJECT_ROOT" bash "$HANDLER" || exit 2
